baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ, فَزِعُوا, فَلَا فَوْتَ, and أُخِذُوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A scene is opened to sight, panic erupts, evasive reach is expressly canceled, and passive seizure completes the sequence. Perception, affect, lost mobility, and capture occur as one compressed event.

activation_trace.role: Direct or insight-like perception supplies the witnessing frame in which the event becomes present.
Terror and recoil from danger supply the subjects' abrupt affective contraction.
Failure of attainment or escape supplies the explicit closure of evasive reach.
Seizing a captive supplies the external act that terminates the panic sequence.

changed_reading.before: A report that frightened people are caught.
changed_reading.after: A disclosed capture sequence in which panic coincides with the extinction of evasive reach and culminates in arrest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacency of فَلَا فَوْتَ and مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negated فوت can image not only failed escape but the absence of a usable interval; مكان locates the operation, and قريب places its source already within reach. Capture therefore need not conclude a chase.

activation_trace.role: A gap or opening between two things supplies the spatial interval that the negation removes.
Place and emplacement supply a concrete operational site for the seizure.
Nearness rather than distance makes the captors' reach immediate.

changed_reading.before: Pursuit closes distance until the people can no longer flee.
changed_reading.after: No chase has to close distance: seizure operates from an already near site where no spatial interval functions as escape.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cluster فَلَا فَوْتَ, أُخِذُوا, and قَرِيبٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form of فوت evokes an end arriving before intended repair, أخذ permits being held answerable, and قرب permits temporal imminence. The physical capture can therefore coexist with a sudden accountability reading.

activation_trace.role: A sudden terminal arrival that precludes a final intended act supplies the event's no-more-time quality.
Being taken to account for what issued from a person supplies a juridical layer to the seizure.
An approaching time or promise supplies imminence alongside spatial proximity.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts only bodily apprehension.
changed_reading.after: The bodily seizure also reads as sudden accountability whose near arrival leaves no interval for repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the same root occurs in a passive construction where terror is cleared from hearts and speech resumes; at the focus, terror erupts and is followed by no escape and seizure. The focus panic thus marks the failure of the earlier release pattern.

activation_trace.role: The focus occurrence supplies terror as the immediate onset of closure.
Removal of fear supplies the contrasting possibility of a heart being cleared so that response becomes possible.

structural_cues: 34:23 places the passive fear-root construction before resumed dialogue, whereas 34:51 places active plural panic immediately before فَلَا فَوْتَ.
The same root is followed first by opened speech and later by closed mobility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and opposite continuations; I infer a reversal from cleared fear to fear without clearance. A live alternative is that these are independent fear scenes rather than phases of one pattern.

changed_reading.before: Their panic is a generic reaction to danger.
changed_reading.after: Their panic signals that the surah's earlier fear-clearing possibility is no longer available: affect is not released into speech but sealed into capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The questioned promise is assigned a fixed appointment at which neither delay nor advance is possible. That temporal bracket activates the focus's no-fوت and near-time branches: seizure arrives on a non-negotiable schedule, not merely at a nearby location.

activation_trace.role: Sudden terminal arrival supplies the loss of any last postponement or repair.
Temporal nearness supplies the focus event's imminence.
A promise bounded by a time or place supplies the fixed appointment governing the event.
Deferral to a later time supplies the temporal maneuver explicitly denied.
Advancing ahead supplies the opposite temporal maneuver, also explicitly denied.

structural_cues: 34:29 asks when the promise will occur; 34:30 answers with a fixed appointment and symmetric negations of delay and advance.
34:51 compresses panic, no escape, and seizure under إِذْ, presenting the appointed instant as already occurring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed-time pair and the focus's sudden sequence; I infer that temporal non-slippage is one mechanism of فَلَا فَوْتَ. The alternative is to keep فوت purely spatial and the appointment only thematic.

changed_reading.before: Capture happens suddenly at an unspecified moment.
changed_reading.after: Capture realizes a fixed appointment: no escape includes the impossibility of moving its time backward or forward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ tableau shows wrongdoers held in place; they later see punishment as necks are bound, and opponents of the signs are made present in punishment. The focus repeats the viewing frame and condenses this grammar of immobilization into no escape and seizure.

activation_trace.role: Perception supplies the focus tableau's disclosed viewpoint.
Captive seizure supplies the culmination of the immobilization sequence.
A matching act of seeing supplies the earlier tableau that the focus construction recalls.
Fixed standing and remaining in a place supply the first form of compelled immobility.
The subjects' own sight of punishment turns disclosure from observer-facing scene into experienced recognition.
A collar that binds an organ supplies material restraint.
The neck supplies the bodily site on which restraint is fixed.
Forced presence and nearness supply movement into the judgment space rather than movement away from it.

structural_cues: The exact frame وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ occurs at 34:31 and 34:51.
The passive forms مَوْقُوفُونَ, مُحْضَرُونَ, and أُخِذُوا distribute agency away from the captured subjects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated visual framing and several compelled states; I infer an escalating grammar from stopped, to bound, to made present, to seized. These may instead be parallel judgment images without temporal escalation.

changed_reading.before: 34:51 is an isolated scene of ambush.
changed_reading.after: 34:51 culminates a recurring disclosed immobilization: the subjects are stopped, materially bound, forced into presence, and finally seized.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier proximity is a valued relation that wealth and children cannot produce; immediately before the focus, divine hearing is paired with nearness. The focus then turns nearness into the range from which seizure operates, reversing sought relational proximity into unavoidable exposure.

activation_trace.role: Operative nearness supplies the range from which seizure is immediate.
Approach to God through an accepted means supplies nearness as a sought and evaluated relation.
Perceptive hearing supplies the preceding nearness with an awareness relation, not distance alone.
The explicit divine attribute of nearness supplies the immediate contextual pole for the focus's nearby place.

structural_cues: 34:37 denies that possessions and children can bring their owners near, while faith and right action mark the exception.
34:50 ends with سَمِيعٌ قَرِيبٌ and 34:51 ends with مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies evaluated nearness and the adjacent hearing-nearness/focus-near pair; I infer a reversal from chosen approach to unavoidable exposure. The live alternative is that the focus adjective is only local and carries no relational force.

changed_reading.before: Near describes only the captors' physical location.
changed_reading.after: Near also carries a value reversal: proximity that cannot be bought or mediated becomes unavoidable exposure within the range of hearing and seizure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus says they are taken from a near place; the next ayah asks how they could perform reaching from a far place. The mirrored place phrases reverse agency: seizure can reach them without interval, but their belated reaching toward belief or rescue cannot cross the distance.

activation_trace.role: Taking and bringing something into one's grasp supply successful reach exercised upon the subjects.
The focus place supplies one pole of the explicit near/far spatial mirror.
Nearness makes the seizure's reach effective.
Extending to take and successfully reach something supplies the agency now questioned or denied.
The repeated place construction supplies the matching second pole of the spatial mirror.
Distance opposed to nearness makes their attempted reach ineffective.

structural_cues: The adjacent phrases مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ and مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ repeat preposition, noun, and adjective slot while reversing the adjective.
Passive أُخِذُوا marks successful action upon them; the rhetorical وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ questions action available to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact near/far constructional mirror and opposed grasping roles; I infer an asymmetry of agency and reach. The alternative is to treat the two locations as unrelated descriptions.

changed_reading.before: They happen to be captured nearby.
changed_reading.after: They are completely reachable by seizure while their own belated attempt to reach belief or rescue is stranded at a distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah installs a separator between the subjects and what they desire. This converts the focus's no-escape statement from blocked locomotion alone into a broader relation of non-attainment: the desired object remains across an imposed divide.

activation_trace.role: Failed attainment or escape supplies the focus's general closure of access.
An intervening barrier that separates two things supplies the mechanism that makes access fail.
Repeated between-positions supply an explicit relation of separation between subject and object.
The self's pull toward what it desires supplies the inaccessible target across the barrier.

structural_cues: 34:54 follows the near capture and far-reaching statements with a passive barrier construction.
The doubled بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ grammatically places the parties on opposite sides of the imposed separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies no escape, failed far-reaching, and then an imposed subject-object barrier; I infer that the barrier completes the focus's closure mechanism. The alternative is that 34:54 concerns desire alone and should not broaden the locomotion of 34:51.

changed_reading.before: No escape means they cannot run away from capture.
changed_reading.after: No escape also means no attainment: an imposed divide prevents them from reaching what the self now wants.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a physical-looking capture through an epistemic geometry of projection. It remains anchored in the focus's seeing and near-place language and in the packet's repeated casting, unseen, and far-place sequence. Downstream prose should mark it as a spatial-epistemic analogy, not claim that قذف lexically governs 34:51.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تَرَىٰ and مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ, contrasted with the casting and far-place language of 34:48 and 34:53.

activation_trace.role: Actual or insight-like sight supplies the replacement of remote conjecture by disclosed presence.
Nearness supplies the collapsed distance at which consequences become operative.
Projection or casting across distance supplies truth's forceful arrival into the sequence.
The repeated casting image supplies the subjects' contrary act of projecting claims from afar.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible object of their projection.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies the epistemic gap from which they had been casting.

changed_reading.before: The focus depicts only a nearby physical arrest.
changed_reading.after: The arrest also images an epistemic distance collapse: remote projection toward the unseen ends when the scene becomes visible and consequence acts at near range.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus form ordinarily presents terror, while another live branch of the same root concerns turning to refuge or aid. It remains anchored in فَزِعُوا and فَلَا فَوْتَ; downstream prose should describe a possible refuge reflex within panic, not translate فَزِعُوا as 'they sought refuge.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The immediate coupling of فَزِعُوا with فَلَا فَوْتَ and أُخِذُوا.

activation_trace.role: Turning toward a refuge when danger strikes supplies a latent action impulse inside the panic.
Failed access or escape prevents that refuge impulse from reaching an effective shelter.
Capture terminates the attempted orientation toward safety before it can function.

changed_reading.before: Panic is only an internal emotional state.
changed_reading.after: Panic may include an abortive reflex toward refuge, but no reachable shelter intervenes before seizure.

strongest_changes: The 34:23 fear-root reversal changes panic from generic emotion into fear for which the earlier clearing pattern is unavailable.
The exact 34:51-52 near/far place mirror changes capture into an asymmetry: they are reachable by seizure but cannot reach from belated distance.
The fixed appointment of 34:30 and imposed barrier of 34:54 extend فَلَا فَوْتَ across time, space, and desired attainment.
Repeated seeing, stopping, binding, forced presence, and passive seizure make 34:51 the culmination of a disclosed immobilization pattern.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context activated several coexisting geometries around the focus: visual disclosure, juridical immobilization, fixed time, valued versus coercive proximity, successful taking versus failed reaching, and an epistemic near/far collapse. The adjacent 34:50-54 sequence sharpened these without reducing them to one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ is primarily a literal capture site, temporal imminence, relational nearness, or deliberately supports several layers.
Whether the fear clearing at 34:23 is meant as a direct reversal of 34:51 or is only a reusable root contrast.
How much weight the exploratory casting/unseen geometry should carry beyond the explicit near/far constructional mirror.
